lifecycle.origin: Created 2026-08-18 by KERNEL_BUILDER-20260818-130753 under the Operator directive that no PostgreSQL or SQLite dependency OR LANGUAGE may remain in tests and checks. Measured during MT-128 implementation: the pg_proof_support fixture conversion REMOVED run_fixture_sql, leaving hard-broken call sites in test_stage_interop.rs (6), test_calendar_interop.rs (6), and test_flight_recorder_authz.rs (1) — those binaries cannot compile. Beyond the compile breaks, ~80 frontend test files still carry PostgreSQL/psql/PG-DSN language in comments, helper names, env-var lists, and gated-row wording, and the shared fixture directory itself is named pg_proof_support. test_e7_swarm_edit_proof.rs was already fully ported under MT-128 (its own scope) and is the reference conversion.

scope.summary: Port the remaining frontend test-suite PostgreSQL verification to embedded-SurrealDB-era patterns and purge PostgreSQL/SQLite language from the frontend test tree. CROSS-FILE NOTE: renaming the MT-074 test mt074-op01-save-persists-exact-embed-provenance-in-postgresql must also update the comment referencing it at src/frontend/handshake_native/src/app.rs:755 (that one comment edit is authorized same-change scope). The reference conversion is test_e7_swarm_edit_proof.rs as ported under MT-128: live-phase row verification goes through product HTTP APIs (documents load, /workspaces list, /workspaces/{id}/loom/blocks/{block}/backlinks, /kernel/events/aggregates/{type}/{id}, credentialed /events); crash-path verification becomes containment observation (the per-run embedded store under a fixture-owned runtime root cannot leak into other runs); shared-cluster sweeps are retired as out-of-band ledger mutation. The pg_proof_support directory is renamed to a database-neutral name (e.g. proof_support or backend_proof_support) with all module references updated across every consuming binary in one change.

acceptance_criteria.text: Every former run_fixture_sql call site is ported to a product-API or containment-observation proof of EQUIVALENT strength (no assertion is weakened or deleted to make a binary compile), and every affected binary compiles.

No file under src/frontend/handshake_native/tests/ contains PostgreSQL, psql, SQLite, PG-DSN, or PL/pgSQL language — identifiers, env-var names, comments, log strings, or module names — except where a string is a deliberate forbidden-technology tripwire whose purpose is detection.
The pg_proof_support module is renamed database-neutrally and every consuming binary's imports are updated in the same change; git history preserves the rename.

The ported binaries' previously-passing tests still pass on the pinned toolchain (run per binary with --test-threads=1 and the sweep run-configuration lessons from MT-108/MT-127: HANDSHAKE_GPU_SCREENSHOT=1 where pixel rows exist, per-binary scoped HANDSHAKE_DATA_DIR isolation).

proof_targets: PT-140-1: repo-wide scan output proving zero PostgreSQL/SQLite language matches under the frontend test tree (tripwire exceptions enumerated).
PT-140-2: per-binary test results for test_stage_interop, test_calendar_interop, test_flight_recorder_authz and every other touched binary, green on the pinned toolchain.
PT-140-3: a diff summary mapping each former run_fixture_sql site to its replacement proof and stating why the replacement is not weaker.
scope.risk_if_missed: Broken binaries silently hold AC-108-3 red; forbidden PostgreSQL language survives in the proof surface the Operator ordered purged; and the next implementer re-diagnoses the removed fixture method from scratch.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Test-harness port; the UI surfaces these tests exercise are owned and proven by their own microtasks.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Pure test-harness change: no product behavior, tool, command, IPC channel, config key, or navigation path changes.

risks: A port that replaces an exact-row SQL assertion with a weaker HTTP existence check silently reduces proof strength (AC-140-1 exists to catch this).
A blanket find/replace of the module name could corrupt string literals that are deliberate tripwires.
Deleting a broken call site instead of porting it converts a canonical-row proof into no proof.
minimum_controls: Each replacement proof maps 1:1 to the SQL predicate it replaces and is recorded in PT-140-3.
Tripwire strings that hunt forbidden technology are preserved and enumerated.
No assertion may be deleted without a recorded equivalent.

hbr_obligations.INT: HBR-INT-009: Flight Recorder NOT_APPLICABLE (test-harness port, no product business event); internal_diagnostics and Palmistry DEFERRED-with-reason while unshipped per CX-981-005.
